mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_history (id, channel, template_code, recipient, subject, content, status, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{channel}, #{templateCode}, #{recipient}, #{subject}, #{content}, #{status}, NOW())

INSERT INTO notification_history (id, channel, template_code, recipient, subject, content, status, created_at) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.channel}, #{item.templateCode}, #{item.recipient}, #{item.subject}, #{item.content}, #{item.status}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_history SET status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE notification_history SET is_read = TRUE, read_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM notification_history WHERE recipient = #{recipient} AND channel = 'IN_APP' AND is_read = FALSE
